message: `parallel-length` may panic here, and a module of this package, held to no panic by default (`--allow-panics` relaxes the modules `noPanic` does not list), may keep no panic site but out of memory: `parallelMapInto` panics when `dst` is shorter than `src`: guard the call with `if (dst.length < src.length) return`, or map in place with `src` as `dst`, and the check is proven
